subject.title: fix(openai): redact token refresh error response body

question: Should this PR be narrowed to redaction-only with corrected claims, or must it enforce the intended 16 KiB bound on the original OpenAI token failure response before merge?
rationale: The current patch provides useful redaction but not its claimed streaming boundary, so the acceptable security scope requires explicit maintainer intent.

options.title: Require the real 16 KiB boundary
options.body: Refactor non-OK handling before the 1 MiB success read and prove early cancellation for refresh and exchange.

options.title: Accept redaction-only scope
options.body: Keep the formatter change but correct the PR text and proof to state that failure-response consumption remains capped at 1 MiB.

options.title: Combine both sibling fixes
options.body: Pause this PR and the exchange PR in favor of one shared token-response boundary refactor.

recommendation.title: Require the real 16 KiB boundary
recommendation.body: Refactor non-OK handling before the 1 MiB success read and prove early cancellation for refresh and exchange.

likelyOwner.reason: They most recently changed this runtime and established the adjacent OAuth provider-error pattern.
